required_conditions: An auditable mapping from every RCD numeric concept node used by the comparison graph to the frozen JUNYI_MID_MODEL_V1 Topic/Q-matrix semantics, without inferred identifiers.
A documented exercise identity mapping from the RCD reference data to the frozen derived Exercise index, without relying on row order or coincidental numeric values.
The resulting common concept graph must remain raw/reference evidence and must not be treated as a Published Graph.
on_missing_conditions: Emit NOT_COMPARABLE_ON_COMMON_GRAPH, do not train RCD on a mismatched graph, and do not place a reference reproduction in the fair comparison table.
